_provenance.source: the canonical omnibase_core and omniclaude clones under OMNI_HOME on lab host h201, at the origin/dev head each hosted git clone --depth 1 of the default branch checks out
_provenance.command: git -C <clone> remote get-url origin; git -C <clone> symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD; git -C <clone> rev-parse origin/dev; git -C <clone> ls-tree --full-tree <commit> -- <paths the pre-push hooks read>
